snapshots.extractedTextSnippet: Applying to KAUST | King Abdullah University Top Home Study Applying to KAUST Applying to KAUST Thank you for your interest in King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST). We suggest you carefully review the list of requirements below and prepare your application in advance of the deadline. Application Deadlines  APPLICATIONS FOR 2026 ARE CLOSED APPLICATIONS FOR 2027 ENTRY WILL OPEN IN MID-AUGUST Application Requirements KAUST requires a minimum TOEFL score of 81 on the IBT (Internet Based Test) or 6.5 on the IELTS (International English Language Testing System). The KAUST admissions code is 4107. Only official TOEFL or IELTS scores will be accepted.
